## 入学条件 {#admissions}

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>A-level标准要求（概览）：</strong>BBC - CCC 包括 化学及either 生物 或 数学, plus one further rigorous academic subject. You will also need to meet the University&#x27;s contextual admissions (widening participation) selection criteria detailed on our application process page under &#x27;how your application is considered&#x27;.；本页还有科目及其他条件，完整条件本轮待逐条审校。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-6a294592cceccf">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>IB标准要求：</strong>IB总分栏列30；条件涉及数学、IB数学AI、化学、生物等科目。本轮已取得完整原文，但科目组合、替代条件及例外尚待逐条中文整理；所列科目不表示全部必修，仅凭总成绩不能判断合格。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-6a294592cceccf">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>英语要求：</strong>All applicants to the University (from the UK) are required to show evidence of 英语 Language proficiency The minimum 英语 Language requirement for this course is: GCSE/iGCSE 英语 Language grade 5/B</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-6a294592cceccf">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>面试要求：</strong>课程页提供面试及甄选安排；不同申请背景可能适用不同流程，本轮尚待将完整规则逐条整理。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-6a294592cceccf">官方依据</a></p>
